Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::createLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		found: Set(LoanTerm) = LoanTerm.allInstance()->select(o|o.ItemID = itemid and
		o.Content = content)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		let newTerm: LoanTerm in
		newTerm.oclIsNew() and
		found.isEmpty() = true and
		LoanTerm.allInstance()->includes(newTerm) and
		newTerm.ItemID = itemid and
		newTerm.Content = content and
		result = true or
		found.isEmpty() = false and
		result = true
}
